purpose: Append-only MaterialStateRef retirement/tombstone used to preserve identity and history continuity after protected material payload is redacted or becomes unavailable, including after disaster recovery.

columns.name: material_state_ref
columns.meaning: Retired MaterialStateRef whose address/envelope continuity remains canonical.

columns.name: recovery_suppression_ref
columns.meaning: Technical UUIDv7 linking the canonical retirement to its independently durable recovery suppression record; not a Domain identity.
columns.value_contract: UUIDv7 and globally unique in this table

primary_key.name: pk_material_state_retirement
primary_key.reason: At most one immutable retirement/tombstone per MaterialStateRef.

foreign_keys.name: fk_material_state_retirement_material_state_ref_material_state_address
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Retirement retains the already-issued MaterialStateRef address instead of replacing or reusing it.

unique_constraints.name: uq_material_state_retirement_recovery_suppression_ref
unique_constraints.reason: One technical suppression record may authorize exactly one canonical MaterialState retirement.

check_constraints.name: ck_material_state_retirement_retired_at
check_constraints.reason: Retirement time is a real finite instant.

check_constraints.name: ck_material_state_retirement_recovery_suppression_uuidv7
check_constraints.reason: Recovery suppression identifiers follow the application-owned UUIDv7 policy without becoming a semantic reference family.

triggers.name: ctrg_material_state_retirement_integrity
triggers.reason: At commit, retirement is append-only and protected facet payload must already be absent.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Retires payload without deleting the MaterialStateRef address or immutable state envelope.
state_history.current_binding: Existing current/history bindings may continue to reference the retired MaterialStateRef so absence is explicit rather than falsified.
state_history.chronology: retired_at records the accepted canonical lifecycle transition; the row itself is append-only.
state_history.immutability_policy: INSERT once; UPDATE and DELETE are rejected by deferred integrity validation.

lifecycle.retention: Retain while MaterialStateRef/reference-history continuity is required; recovery suppression evidence must survive at least as long as any retained backup/WAL/object version can resurrect the protected payload.
lifecycle.redaction: Canonical payload redaction is accepted only when protected payload is absent and this tombstone is committed.
lifecycle.retirement_tombstone: This row is the canonical PostgreSQL tombstone; independently durable PREPARED+COMMITTED recovery evidence prevents stale-backup resurrection.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime delete; retirement rows are append-only and not garbage-collected while resurrection or reference-continuity obligations remain.
